shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,85p' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md && rg -n -i -C 2 'dashboard|chart|grid|uikit|drag' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md && cat package.json && sed -n '1,240p' src/App.tsx && sed -n '1,200p' src/main.tsx && rg -n -C 3 'typography|Button|Icon|Flex|ThemeProvider|grid|color' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md"

/bin/bash -lc ".agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh dashkit && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/README.md | sed -n '1,220p' && rg --files node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit | head -60"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n 'Required setup|styles|DashKit\\.setSettings|registerPlugins|renderer|DashKitProps|interface SettingsProps|type SettingsProps|gridLayout' node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/docs/INDEX.md node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/README.md | head -90 && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/package.json | head -70 && sed -n '1,140p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm/index.d.ts && rg -n 'DashKit|Widget' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md"

/bin/bash -lc "rg --files node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit | rg '\\.(css|scss)"'$'"' | head -30; rg -n 'interface SettingsProps|type SettingsProps|interface Plugin|interface ConfigItem|itemsStateAndParams|globalParams' node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm -g '*.d.ts' | head -60;"

/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
p='src/App.tsx'
s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace('<Icon data={Ellipsis} size={18}/>','<Glyph>···</Glyph>')
s=s.replace('<Icon data={ArrowUpRightFromSquare} size={14}/>','<Glyph>↗</Glyph>')
s=s.replace('<Icon data={Gear} size={18}/>','<Glyph>⚙</Glyph>')
s=s.replace('<Icon data={editing?Sliders:Gear} size={16}/>','<Glyph>{editing?\"⠿\":\"⚙\"}</Glyph>')
s=s.replace('<Icon data={Plus} size={16}/>','<Glyph>＋</Glyph>')
s=s.replace('<Icon data={Sliders} size={16}/>','<Glyph>☷</Glyph>')
open(p,'w').write(s)
PY
"
